Title: Mark single attendance present valid employee
Description: Verify marking single attendance as present for valid employeeId and date
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with employeeId=1, absent=false, date=2025-01-01
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains attendance record with employeeId=1, absent=false, date=2025-01-01
Expected Result: Attendance record is created or updated with absent=false for employeeId=1 on 2025-01-01

Title: Mark single attendance absent valid employee
Description: Verify marking single attendance as absent for valid employeeId and date
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with employeeId=2, absent=true, date=2025-01-01
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains attendance record with employeeId=2, absent=true, date=2025-01-01
Expected Result: Attendance record is created or updated with absent=true for employeeId=2 on 2025-01-01

Title: Mark single attendance missing employeeId
Description: Verify error response when employeeId is missing in request body
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with absent=false, date=2025-01-02 and no employeeId
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'employeeI and absent required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 with error message about missing employeeId and absent

Title: Mark single attendance invalid employeeId
Description: Verify marking attendance with invalid employeeId returns error or handles gracefully
Pre-Conditions: Employee with ID -1 does not exist
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with employeeId=-1, absent=false, date=2025-01-03
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify attendance record is created or updated with employeeId=-1 and absent=false on 2025-01-03
Verify employee counters are not updated as employee does not exist
Expected Result: Attendance record is created or updated for employeeId=-1; employee counters unchanged

Title: Mark single attendance future date boundary
Description: Verify marking attendance on future date boundary is accepted
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with employeeId=3, absent=false, date=2099-12-31
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains attendance record with employeeId=3, absent=false, date=2099-12-31
Expected Result: Attendance record is created or updated with absent=false for employeeId=3 on 2099-12-31

Title: Mark batch attendance valid entries
Description: Verify batch marking attendance with multiple valid entries
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with payload containing attendance for employeeId=1 present and employeeId=2 absent on 2025-01-01
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains savedCount=2
Verify presentCount=1 and absentCount=1
Verify invalidEntries list is empty
Expected Result: Two attendance records created or updated; counts and invalidEntries correct

Title: Mark batch attendance with missing employeeId
Description: Verify batch marking attendance handles entries with missing employeeId
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with payload containing one valid entry and one entry missing employeeId
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify savedCount=1
Verify invalidEntries list contains no employeeId for missing entry
Verify presentCount and absentCount reflect only valid entries
Expected Result: One attendance record saved; invalidEntries list empty or does not include null employeeId

Title: Mark batch attendance with invalid employeeId
Description: Verify batch marking attendance handles entries with invalid employeeId
Pre-Conditions: Employee with ID -1 does not exist
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with payload containing one valid entry and one entry with employeeId=-1
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify savedCount=2
Verify invalidEntries list does not include -1
Verify attendance records created or updated for both entries
Expected Result: Two attendance records saved; invalidEntries list empty

Title: Mark batch attendance empty payload
Description: Verify error response when batch attendance payload is empty
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with empty array payload
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'payload is empty'
Expected Result: Response status 400 with error message about empty payload

Title: Mark batch attendance future date boundary
Description: Verify batch marking attendance on future date boundary is accepted
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with one entry for employeeId=3 absent=false on 2099-12-31
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify savedCount=1
Verify presentCount=1 and absentCount=0
Verify invalidEntries list is empty
Expected Result: Attendance record created or updated for employeeId=3 on 2099-12-31; counts correct

Title: Get all employees successfully
Description: Verify that GET /api/employe returns a list of all employees with status 200
Pre-Conditions: At least one employee exists in the repository
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employe
Verify response status code is 200
Verify response body is a list
Verify list contains employee objects with id, name, role, and absent fields
Expected Result: Response status 200 with JSON array of employees
